# Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` at the repository root before writing or editing any code in a Widdx
project. It is the complete, authoritative handbook — one atomic fact per line.

Order that matters: **PART 2A = the LAWS** (binding — a task that breaks one has failed, even
if the page renders; it carries the file-placement map, the per-task command order, and the
six-point definition of done), **PART 23 = the only callable API list** (a name outside it does
not exist; `Model` has no `__callStatic`, so a guessed static fatals), **PART 24 = measured
traps**. Then PART 0 (start), PART 2 (golden rules), PART 4 (inference), PART 21 (pitfalls),
PART 22 ("user asks for X → you write Y").

Do not restate its facts here. This file only points at it, so the handbook stays the
single source of truth.
